results.title: All The Devils Are Here
results.overview: A young man has an unexpected visitor. All goes haywire from there.

results.title: Barood
results.overview: Barood is a story of today's youngsters being exploited by corruption. Jui, an innocent girl, falls in love with a loafer Shaon. And this turns Shaon's life upside down. The lovebirds wish to live a fairytale life but the circumstances are against them. In the race between love and society - who wins?

results.title: Ozhiyathe
results.overview: In August 1976, 19 schoolboys from Koduvayoor were arrested without cause and tormented for 21 days under the Emergency. Ozhiyathe brings this unrecorded true story of injustice and resilience finally to light.

results.title: Why Did I Get Married Again?
results.original_title: Why Did I Get Married Again?
results.overview: The couples reunite for the destination wedding of Marcus and Angela's daughter, bringing drama old and new as they ask, "Why did we get married again?"

results.title: Wild Tamil Nadu
results.overview: Wild Tamil Nadu is a spectacular new natural history film that reveals the extraordinary biodiversity of Tamil Nadu- a land where rainforests, reefs, and deserts meet in one of the most unique ecological landscapes on Earth.

results.title: THE UNKNOWN GUN MAN
results.overview: While meditating on his terrace, Shubh discovers a mysterious gun wrapped with a chilling message: “Please hide this. He is coming.” Confused and frightened, he hides the weapon, unaware that someone is already looking for it. As Shubh tries to make sense of what has happened, a mysterious stranger finally arrives, turning an ordinary evening into a terrifying encounter.

results.title: Instadocs: The Decoy Plane
results.overview: A critical threat. A clandestine escape. And a Turkish catering truck? With firsthand accounts, "Instadocs" digs into what happened aboard Air Force One.

results.title: Dhurandhar: The Fall
results.overview: After a major accident leaves him injured and confined to his home for months, a young guy named Dipansh is forced to face pain, isolation, and uncertainty.  With little support around him, he begins navigating his recovery largely on his own, while confronting the unexpected actions of those he once called friends.  What begins as a physical fall slowly becomes a much deeper battle within.  A documentary short film by himself.

results.title: Go Get It
results.overview: When a bizarre glitch throws the orders of a popular five-minute delivery app into chaos, a delivery rider finds himself caught in a chain reaction of increasingly dangerous mix-ups.

results.title: Famous Last Words: Gloria Steinem
results.overview: Before her death, activist Gloria Steinem shared her final, heartfelt message with the world, knowing this interview would not air until she was gone.

results.title: Mayday
results.overview: When a U.S. Navy pilot on a top-secret mission during the Cold War gets trapped behind enemy lines, his only chance at survival is to form an alliance with an eccentric ex-KGB agent.

results.title: THE SCRIPT??
results.overview: A writer's final night before the deadline that will decide whether he ever writes again.

results.title: Turning Point: Generation 9/11
results.overview: A quarter-century after September 11th, the attacks' ripple effects persist across generations. Orphaned children, War on Terror journalists, young Afghans, and U.S. Marines shaped by the 2021 withdrawal share their stories.

results.title: Yedho Ondru Ennai Thakka Case 01
results.overview: A mysterious hacker uses phones to kidnap people, while detectives JaiKumar & Thiru race to uncover the mastermind behind a deadly chain of crimes.

results.title: Untold Raygun: Breaking Badly
results.overview: Nobody, least of all Rachael Gunn, expected to be an Olympian. But as Raygun’s performance at the 2024 Paris Olympics went viral overnight, so did an avalanche of memes, misinformation, and conspiracy theories questioning how she ever got there.

results.title: Blaring Fabrics
results.overview: A simple overview into the fabric of a cotton leaf.

results.title: Sylvia - Kafka
results.overview: Sylvia looks back at a life altered by love, loss, and change. In literature, she finds a way to give her memories meaning and slowly come to understand herself.

results.title: The Hiding Man
results.overview: A man sees something... different and strange. What is it that he sees?

results.title: Radio 11:11 Part-2 : The Origin
results.overview: It reveals the origin of the mystery — the story of Arvind Mehra, Arjun Mehra and the creation of Tempora. After Arjun mysteriously disappears during the machine’s first activation, Arvind’s research leads to Radio 11:11 and its strange connection with lightning and time. What happened to Arvind that night, and why does the mystery repeat every 11 years? The answers begin to unfold in 2026.

results.title: Tom & Cherry
results.overview: When Tom suddenly disappears, a mysterious man named Cheer becomes part of an extraordinary journey that no one sees coming. Packed with laughter, emotions, unexpected twists, and heartwarming moments, Tom and Cherry is a wholesome family entertainer that celebrates the true meaning of love and togetherness.
